design.decision: Make your own contract first, then spend the remaining tricks setting the opponents.
design.opponent: Shown on the first set. Opponents shade their bids down.
design.rationale: This is the points version of defence, which also needs a make because contract points are lost on a set. That gives it a different risk profile from the multiplier, so both are worth measuring.
design.draftText: +60 contract points if the opponents miss their contract

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-oppset-pts); credited to both sources.
